notice: **CCU:** Claude Consumption Unit. A CCU is a unit of measure used solely for Marketplace Platform invoicing. If Customer accesses the Services through certain Marketplace Platforms (for example, Claude Platform on AWS), usage is invoiced in Claude Consumption Units (“CCU”) rather than per MTok. One hundred (100) CCU represents $1.00 USD of fees owed for the Services, calculated at the applicable prices in the [API section of the Claude pricing page](https://claude.com/pricing#api), after application of any discounts.
